images.title: Reading the date from 1390
images.purpose: Shows that 1390 minus 165 leaves 1225, which splits into month 12 and day 25.
images.composition: A large number on the left, one arrow, and the result split into two coloured digit groups on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: the number 1390 in large dark numerals. One arrow pointing right, with − 165 written above it. Right: the result drawn as two adjacent digit groups with a thin gap between them, 12 in teal #0072B2 and 25 in amber #E69F00; the result is never written as one plain number. Under 12 the word month in teal #0072B2; under 25 the word day in amber #E69F00. Below the whole row, centred, 25 December in reddish purple #CC79A7. Nothing else is drawn. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, which is large and centred; no scenery, no people, no other text.

images.takeaway: Take away 165: the last two digits are the day, the rest is the month.
images.description: Shows that 1390 minus 165 leaves 1225, which splits into month 12 and day 25.
images.context: Picture for reading a date from the answer 1390 in the date trick.
images.teaching_notes: The month has two digits here; ask why the day must be the last two digits.

image_decisions.why: The colour split of 1225 into 12 and 25 shows where the month and day sit, which is the whole idea.
